PHI Protection Pipeline (De-identification → Model Call → Audit)

nodes.label: Caching Strategy
nodes.rationale: Cache per (patient, encounter, data-version-hash), regenerate only if underlying chart data changed; async pre-warm option reduces perceived latency to near-zero at chart open.

nodes.label: De-identification Boundary
nodes.rationale: Reduces PHI surface even though the transport layer is already BAA-covered — defense in depth. Patient identifiers are stripped/tokenized before leaving the service; a server-side mapping table re-associates the summary with the patient record afterward.

nodes.label: Latency Budget (<3s)
nodes.rationale: Chart review is a high-frequency, time-sensitive workflow, so summary generation targets under 3s perceived latency.

nodes.label: Output JSON Contract
nodes.rationale: Claude returns a fixed JSON schema (not free text) so the frontend can render deterministic UI sections rather than parsing prose.

nodes.label: Server-side Model Call Decision
nodes.rationale: Keeps PHI off the browser/network edge and centralizes BAA compliance.

nodes.label: Banner Health
nodes.rationale: CTO cited Anthropic's safety focus and Constitutional AI approach as the deciding factor in vendor choice; planned expansion into customer experience, revenue cycle, and supply chain shows a single platform scaling across non-clinical operations too.

nodes.label: Elation Health
nodes.rationale: Elation building Claude directly into its own EHR product (rather than via a hospital-system integration layer) reflects Anthropic's current healthcare distribution model — going through health-tech vendors — contrasted with competitors partnering directly with dominant EHR incumbents.

nodes.label: Elation Health Chart-Summary Development Plan
nodes.rationale: Assumes building a prototype/demo of the HLD/LLD feature, not a production integration with Elation's actual system; a real production integration would need Elation's actual API/data contracts substituted for the mocked assumptions.

nodes.label: Elation Health × Claude HLD & LLD
nodes.rationale: Elation's internal architecture isn't publicly documented beyond the 61% chart-review-time reduction claim; this design is an inferred architecture based on the public case study, standard EHR integration patterns, and HIPAA-compliant AI deployment practice.

nodes.label: Distribution Model
nodes.rationale: Anthropic's healthcare reach currently runs through health-tech vendors (Elation, Commure, Carta) and health systems building on the API (Banner), rather than a single EHR-incumbent partnership — a contrast to OpenAI's Microsoft/Epic route.

nodes.label: Carta Healthcare
nodes.rationale: CTO framed this as a 'complete re-invention of understanding a patient's medical record'; Bedrock deployment enables rapid, secure deployment of new Claude models — a template for regulated-industry deployment via cloud model marketplaces.

nodes.label: Model Access Path: Bedrock over Direct API
nodes.norm_label: model access path: bedrock over direct api
nodes.rationale: Matches Carta's pattern of 'rapid, secure deployment'; simplifies key management and regional data residency.

nodes.label: Qualified Health
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates Claude operating at population-health scale across fragmented, multi-source medical records rather than requiring a single unified EHR.

nodes.label: BAA Compliance
nodes.rationale: No PHI flows until compliance sign-off is approved; gates all subsequent phases that handle real PHI.

nodes.label: Prototype/Demo Scope Assumption
nodes.rationale: Plan assumes building a prototype/demo of the HLD/LLD feature, not modifying Elation's actual production system (no access to it); a real production integration would need Elation's actual API/data contracts substituted for the mocked assumptions.

nodes.label: Error Handling Table
nodes.rationale: Fail safely: fall back silently to raw chart view on Claude API timeout/error or malformed response (retry once first); return a 'not enough data to summarize' state rather than guessing when the model flags insufficient data.

nodes.label: Commure
nodes.rationale: CTO framed precision as 'the prerequisite for trust' — the clearest articulation of why accuracy, not just automation, is the binding constraint for ambient clinical AI at scale.

nodes.label: Constitutional AI
nodes.rationale: Anthropic's safety-focused training approach, cited by Banner Health's CTO as the deciding factor in vendor selection over competing AI platforms.

nodes.label: Summary Advisory, Not Authoritative
nodes.rationale: Regulatory and clinical-safety requirement — AI does not replace clinical judgment; clinician always sees/can expand full chart.
